about: 100 ordinary team messages in the shared places (general, standup, leads), none addressed to the agent, with 3 mentions mixed in (A3, A1). Messages marked extra are private-chat notes (dm-*) that A3 does not count. Facts said here that a later question can ask about: the logger manual is in the grey cabinet, second drawer; buoy 14's real serial is K7-0148 (said only in dm-member2); Peedie Marine quoted 160 pounds for the boat on the 21st (said only in dm-member1); the redeploy moved to Tuesday because the battery packs arrive Monday; the cable walk moved from Thursday to next Tuesday; logger gaps are marked null, never interpolated; the Hoy ingest stopped because its service account expired, and Teodor rotated it.

messages.text: Morning all. Ferry from Houton was late again, so I'm in a bit after nine.
Same boat, literally. Coffee's on in the hut.
I'm already in. The heating in the lab is finally fixed.
Yesterday: finished the bootloader image for the Kelpie-7 buoys. Today: bench test on buoy 14. No blockers.
Yesterday: cleaned the Scapa Flow salinity export. Today: start the backfill for March. Blocker: the old logger files are in a format I haven't seen.
Yesterday: route notes for Rackwick. Today: call the survey team about the cable walk. No blockers.
Priya, which logger format is it? I might have the old manual somewhere.
The files end in .slf. Header says Saltmarsh v2.
I do have that manual. It's in the grey cabinet, second drawer, labelled SLF.
Found it, thank you.
Marisol, do we have budget left for a second spare battery pack per buoy?
About two thousand left in field kit. A second pack each for six buoys fits.
Great, I'll order them from Northlink Marine Supply.
Has anyone seen the long USB-C cable? The red one.
It was on the bench by the window yesterday.
Got it.
Reminder that the fire alarm test is at eleven.
Note to self: check the March salinity values against the tide tables before loading.
Note: buoy 14 serial is K7-0148, not K7-0141 like the label says.
Need to book the boat for the cable walk. Ask Peedie Marine about the 21st.
Bench test on 14 passed. Bootloader flashed in under four minutes.
Nice one.
Lunch at the Pier Arts cafe? They've got soup on.
In.
I'll join after my call.
Teodor, can you take the harbour-master meeting on Wednesday? I'm on the cable walk.
Yes, what time?
Two o'clock, at the Stromness harbour office.
Booked in.
The .slf files decode fine with the manual's table. March is loading now.
what is Teodor working on this week?
Update: buoy 15 also passed. Moving to 16 after lunch.
Survey team confirmed the cable walk for Thursday morning, meeting at Rackwick car park at eight.
Bring wellies, the path past the bothy floods.
Noted.
Buoy 16 failed the flash. Watchdog reset halfway through.
Power or firmware?
Looks like power. The bench supply sagged. Trying the other supply.
Other supply works. 16 is flashed.
Peedie Marine can do the boat on the 21st, 160 pounds for the day.
March backfill done. April next.
The battery packs ship Friday, arriving Monday.
Good. Put the invoice in the field kit folder.
Did anyone change the shared drive password? I'm locked out.
IT rotated it this morning. New one is in the vault.
Got in, thanks.
Buoys 17 and 18 done. 19 tomorrow, then all six are on the new bootloader.
April backfill is half done. Some April days have gaps where the logger was down.
Cable walk prep done. Printed the route maps.
Is the van free tomorrow? I need to take two buoys to the slip.
I have it until ten, then it's yours.
Perfect.
Question for whoever knows: do we mark logger gaps as null or interpolate?
Null. We decided last year not to interpolate in the published tables.
Null it is.
Remember to log the K7-0148 serial in the asset sheet.
Weather looks rough for Thursday. Forty knot gusts forecast.
Ugh. Is the walk still on?
Survey team says they'll decide at seven on Thursday.
Harbour master asked if we can share the buoy positions before redeploy.
Yes, send them the planned positions list. Not the raw GPS logs.
Will do.
Anyone want the last of the shortbread? It's in the kitchen.
Already gone, sorry.
Small change: I'm out Friday afternoon, dentist.
Buoy 19 flashed. All six on the new bootloader.
which goals do I own, and when are they due?
Great work.
Brilliant. That's the Kelpie-7 flashing done.
April backfill done. Gaps marked null on the 3rd, 4th and 17th.
Runbook for the flashing is a draft in the shared drive, under field ops.
I'll read it tonight.
The salinity on 12 April looks too high. Checking against the tide table.
It was a spring tide. The value is real.
Teodor, for the redeploy: Monday or Tuesday?
Tuesday. The packs arrive Monday and I want a day to fit them.
Tuesday it is. I'll tell the boat crew.
Heads up, the slip at Stromness is closed Monday for repairs.
Good thing we picked Tuesday.
Does anyone know who owns the station account for Hoy?
That's mine. Why?
The ingest from Hoy stopped at six this morning.
Probably the service account expiry. I'll rotate it today.
Rotated. Hoy ingest is back.
Confirmed, data is flowing.
Tell the survey team about the boat on the 21st.
Next: fit the battery packs Monday, redeploy Tuesday.
Next: May backfill, then the summary table.
Next: cable walk if the weather allows, then write up.
Cable walk is off for Thursday, moved to next Tuesday.
That clashes with the redeploy.
Different boats, different people. It's fine.
Who's covering the lab Tuesday then?
I'll be here all day, so me.
Harbour master has the positions list. They're happy.
Thanks.
May backfill started. First week looks clean.
who is on the team, and what is each person doing?
Has the new label printer arrived?
Tomorrow, apparently.
Label printer is here. Printing the buoy tags now.
May backfill is at the 20th. Clean so far.
Survey team sent the revised route for Tuesday. It skips the bothy path.
Packs fitted on two buoys so far. The rest after lunch.
Summary table has its first week of rows.
Wrote up the cable route notes. Draft in the shared drive.
Does anyone have the torque settings for the buoy housings?
Eight newton metres. It's on the sticker inside the lid.
Found it, thanks.
Draft summary table: one row per day, columns for mean, min and max salinity.
Heading off. See you tomorrow.
Night.
